description:
Given a seed track, return the top-N catalog tracks to play NEXT, ranked by transition
    score. Each suggestion carries the same `score`, per-component scores and human `reason` as
    score_transition (e.g. "11B->11B same key, 118->117 BPM (-0.29), energy +0.12"), plus its
    `genre` and `genre_relation` to the seed. GENRE-AWARE by default (cross_genre=auto): off-genre
    picks that only coincidentally share the seed's key/BPM sink to the bottom — use
    cross_genre=strict for same-genre-family only, or allow for the old harmonic-only ranking. It
    is the seed's sonic neighbours re-ranked for a clean mix.

    Returns `seed`, `count`, and a `suggestions` array of {track, score, components, reason}.
    seed_track_id is a catalog itunes_track_id from search_catalog or a get_audio_features
    result. Pair with build_setlist to order a whole crate. Costs 3 quota units.

bpm_drift.description: Max BPM difference pre-filter before scoring (default 12).
bpm_drift.title: Bpm Drift

cross_genre.description: Genre handling: 'auto' (default) keeps picks in a mixable genre lane so an off-genre track that only shares key/BPM sinks to the bottom; 'strict' = same genre-family only; 'allow' = genre-blind (harmonic+tempo+energy only).
cross_genre.title: Cross Genre

exclude_same_artist.description: Drop tracks by the seed's artist (default false).
exclude_same_artist.title: Exclude Same Artist

max_key_distance.description: Max Camelot-wheel hops pre-filter before scoring (default 2).
max_key_distance.title: Max Key Distance

min_score.description: Drop candidates below this overall transition score (default 0).
min_score.title: Min Score

n.description: How many next-track suggestions to return (default 10).
n.title: N

seed_track_id.description: The track currently playing — a catalog itunes_track_id.
seed_track_id.title: Seed Track Id

name: suggest_next_track
title: Suggest Next Track
